runtime: Python 3.10 or later; standard library only
mathematical_basis: General algebraic proof with independent AI-assisted mathematical review; finite exact tests are corroboration, not exhaustive all-coloring verification.
package_validation: Fresh temporary copies rerun all five original checkers, compare every certificate byte, and reject both changed mathematical certificates and inventory corruption. scope: Structured equal-halves rectangular family; no arbitrary-coloring, general ASNC, P-versus-NP, novelty, human-peer-review, or proof-assistant-verification claim.
